Protection settings

Waiting for the service.

Download pause needs to be enabled in the service. Notify only releases existing whohack blocks and pauses. Automatic response is available only when separately enabled.

Scan a folder

Optionally ask installed Microsoft Defender to inspect a folder and its contents. Live protection still watches the downloaded files you open or run.

Waiting for the service.

Checks report detections by default. Defender uses your Windows cloud protection and sample submission settings. No matches is not a safety verdict. Stopping the client may leave work already submitted to Defender running.

Trusted items

Trust suppresses matching alerts. Only add an app or destination you recognize and intend to exclude.
